--- .mimocode/plans/1789130476451-gentle-lagoon.md	
+++ .mimocode/plans/1789130476451-gentle-lagoon.md	
@@ -0,0 +1,195 @@
+# Backend API Design for Takhte Sholokhte (تخته شلخته) Persian Kanban App
+
+## Overview
+
+Transitioning from localStorage-only to backend-backed architecture with REST API, authentication, and media storage.
+
+---
+
+## Data Model
+
+### Core Types (src/types.ts)
+
+**BoardData** (lines 115-122)
+- `id: string` (UUID)
+- `name: string`
+- `createdAt: string` (ISO)
+- `updatedAt: string` (ISO)
+- `viewport: { x, y, zoom }`
+- `backgroundColor: string`
+
+**Geometry** (lines 14-20)
+- `x, y, width, height, rotation` (numbers)
+
+**TaskCard** (lines 81-99)
+- `id`, `type='taskCard'`, `geometry`, `zIndex`, `appearance`, `metadata`, `contentItems`, `archived`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`
+
+**ContentItem** (lines 79, 22-78)
+- `TextItem`: id, type='text', geometry, style, content{text, textDirection, fontSize, fontWeight, textColor, textAlign}
+- `ImageItem`: id, type='image', geometry, style, content:src{kind:'media-ref'| 'data-url', mediaId?, value?, alt}
+- `ShapeItem`: id, type='shape', geometry, style, content{shapeType, label, textColor, fontSize, textAlign}
+
+**BoardState** (lines 124-133)
+- `schemaVersion: 1`
+- `board: BoardData`
+- `taskCards: TaskCard[]`
+- `history: { past: HistorySnapshot[], future: HistorySnapshot[], log: HistoryLogEntry[] }`
+
+---
+
+## Frontend Operations (traced from src/App.tsx)
+
+### Board Operations
+- `loadState()` - async migration of data-url images
+- `saveState()` - debounced auto-save
+- `exportJson()` - download board as JSON
+- `validateImport()` + `migrateBoardState()` - import JSON with migration
+- `clearState()`
+
+### Card Operations
+- `addCard()` - create new TaskCard at viewport center
+- `updateCard(cardId, updates)` - partial update of TaskCard
+- `archiveCard(cardId)` - set archived=true, push snapshot
+- `restoreCard(cardId)` - set archived=false, push snapshot
+- `deleteCard(cardId)` - delete card + media cleanup
+- `duplicateCard(cardId)` - deep clone with offset
+- `bringToFront(cardId)` / `sendToBack(cardId)` - update zIndex
+
+### Content Operations
+- `addText(cardId)` - add TextItem
+- `addImage(cardId)` - via file input, saveMedia + create ImageItem
+- `addShape(cardId)` - add ShapeItem
+- `updateContent(cardId, contentId, updates)` - partial update
+- `deleteContent(cardId, contentId)` - remove content item
+- `handleTextChange(cardId, contentId, text)` - inline text edit
+
+### History Operations
+- `undo()` / `redo()` - history navigation via snapshots
+- `pushSnapshot(description, affectedId, action)` - internal history
+
+### Viewport Operations
+- `setZoom(delta, cx?, cy?)` - zoom in/out with cursor center
+- `fitScreen()` - auto-fit all cards to viewport
+
+---
+
+## Media Operations (src/mediaService.ts)
+
+- `saveMedia(blob, alt)` → returns mediaId (UUID)
+- `getMedia(mediaId)` → MediaRecord { id, blob, kind, alt, createdAt }
+- `deleteMedia(mediaId)`
+- `clearUnusedMedia(usedIds: Set<string>)` → returns orphaned IDs
+- `listAllMediaIds()`
+- `clearAllMedia()`
+
+---
+
+## Export/Import Format (board-import custom event)
+
+```json
+{
+  "schemaVersion": 1,
+  "board": { "id": "main-board", "name": "تخته", "viewport": {...}, "backgroundColor": "#F7F6F2" },
+  "taskCards": [...],
+  "history": { "past": [], "future": [], "log": [] }
+}
+```
+
+---
+
+## Proposed Backend API (REST + Express)
+
+### Auth Endpoints (if auth added)
+- `POST /api/auth/register` - register new user
+- `POST /api/auth/login` - login, return JWT
+- `GET /api/auth/me` - get current user
+
+### Board Endpoints
+- `GET /api/boards/:boardId` - get board state (return BoardState)
+- `PUT /api/boards/:boardId` - replace entire board (with migration)
+- `PATCH /api/boards/:boardId` - partial board update (viewport, style)
+- `DELETE /api/boards/:boardId` - delete board
+- `GET /api/boards/:boardId/export` - download JSON export
+- `POST /api/boards/:boardId/import` - upload JSON, validate + migrate
+
+### Card Endpoints
+- `POST /api/boards/:boardId/cards` - create new card (pass contentItems)
+- `GET /api/boards/:boardId/cards` - list all cards (including archived)
+- `GET /api/boards/:boardId/cards/:cardId` - get single card
+- `PATCH /api/boards/:boardId/cards/:cardId` - update card
+- `DELETE /api/boards/:boardId/cards/:cardId` - delete card (cleanup media)
+- `POST /api/boards/:boardId/cards/:cardId/archive` - archive card
+- `POST /api/boards/:boardId/cards/:cardId/restore` - restore card
+- `POST /api/boards/:boardId/cards/:cardId/duplicate` - duplicate card
+
+### Content Endpoints
+- `POST /api/boards/:boardId/cards/:cardId/content` - add content item
+- `GET /api/boards/:boardId/cards/:cardId/content/:contentId` - get content
+- `PATCH /api/boards/:boardId/cards/:cardId/content/:contentId` - update content
+- `DELETE /api/boards/:boardId/cards/:cardId/content/:contentId` - delete content
+
+### Media Endpoints
+- `POST /api/media` - upload blob (auth required), return mediaId
+- `GET /api/media/:mediaId` - get media blob (authenticate, authorize)
+- `DELETE /api/media/:mediaId` - delete media
+- `GET /api/media?usedIds=a,b,c` - list all, client filters orphans
+
+### Webhook/Event Endpoints
+- Board import returns `{ validated: BoardState, migrated: true/false }` for frontend to dispatch custom event
+
+---
+
+## Implementation Plan
+
+### Phase 1: Backend Foundation
+1. Set up Express server (`server.js` or `src/server/`)
+2. Database: SQLite or PostgreSQL for boards/cards, separate media storage (file system or S3)
+3. Auth: JWT middleware (optional, can start without)
+4. Basic CRUD routes for boards and cards
+
+### Phase 2: API Endpoints
+1. Implement all endpoints shown above
+2. Add request validation middleware
+3. Add migration endpoints for data-url → media-ref
+4. Add WebSocket for real-time sync (optional)
+
+### Phase 3: Frontend Integration
+1. Replace `persistence.ts` with API client
+2. Update `mediaService.ts` to use blob upload endpoint
+3. Replace localStorage reads/writes with API calls
+4. Add optimistic UI updates
+
+### Phase 4: Testing & Deployment
+1. Test full workflow: create board → add cards → archive → restore → export/import
+2. Deploy to Vercel/Render/Railway with PostgreSQL
+3. Add health checks and monitoring
+
+---
+
+## Files to Create/Modify
+
+**New Files:**
+- `server.js` or `src/server/` - Express server entry
+- `src/server/routes/boards.ts` - board routes
+- `src/server/routes/cards.ts` - card routes
+- `src/server/routes/media.ts` - media routes
+- `src/server/routes/auth.ts` - auth routes (optional)
+- `src/server/db/` - database client
+- `src/server/middleware/auth.ts` - JWT middleware
+
+**Modified Files:**
+- `src/persistence.ts` → `src/api.ts` (API client replacing localStorage)
+- `src/App.tsx` - replace localStorage calls with API calls
+- `package.json` - add express, pg (or sqlite3), cors, jsonwebtoken, multer for uploads
+- `vite.config.ts` - proxy API requests in dev mode
+
+---
+
+## Verification
+
+1. `npm run dev` starts backend on port 3000
+2. `npm run preview` starts frontend on port 8443
+3. Frontend can create boards, add cards, upload images
+4. Auth flow works (if implemented)
+5. Export JSON includes proper schema version
+6. Import old data-url boards migrates correctly
\ No newline at end of file

+# Installation
+
+```bash
+npm install
+npm run dev
+```
+
+**Server runs on:** `http://localhost:3000`
+**Frontend runs on:** `http://localhost:8443`
+
+---
+
+## API Documentation
+
+### Auth Endpoints
+
+**Register:** `POST /api/auth/register`
+```json
+{
+  "email": "user@example.com",
+  "password": "password123"
+}
+```
+
+**Login:** `POST /api/auth/login`
+```json
+{
+  "email": "user@example.com",
+  "password": "password123"
+}
+```
+
+**Me:** `GET /api/auth/me`
+```json
+{
+  "id": "uuid",
+  "email": "user@example.com"
+}
+```
+
+### Board Endpoints
+
+**List Boards:** `GET /api/boards`
+```json
+[{
+  "id": "uuid",
+  "owner_id": "uuid",
+  "name": "تخته",
+  "viewport": {"x":0,"y":0,"zoom":1},
+  "background_color": "#F7F6F2",
+  "created_at": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
+  "updated_at": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
+}]}
+```
+
+**Create Board:** `POST /api/boards`
+```json
+{
+  "name": "تخته جدید",
+  "viewport": {"x":0,"y":0,"zoom":1},
+  "background_color": "#F7F6F2"
+}
+```
+
+**Get Board:** `GET /api/boards/:boardId`
+```json
+{
+  "id": "uuid",
+  "owner_id": "uuid", 
+  "name": "تخته",
+  "viewport": {"x":0,"y":0,"zoom":1},
+  "background_color": "#F7F6F2",
+  "created_at": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
+  "updated_at": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
+  "taskCards": [...] // Full board state
+}
+```
+
+**Update Board:** `PUT /api/boards/:boardId`
+```json
+{
+  "taskCards": [...],
+  "viewport": {"x":0,"y":0,"zoom":1}
+}
+```
+
+**Delete Board:** `DELETE /api/boards/:boardId`
+
+**Import Board:** `POST /api/boards/import`
+```json
+{
+  "boardId": "optional-board-id",
+  "data": { // Full board state including taskCards
+    "schemaVersion": 1,
+    "board": { /* board data */ },
+    "taskCards": [...]
+  }
+}
+```
+
+### Card Endpoints
+
+**List Cards:** `GET /api/cards/:boardId/cards`
+**Create Card:** `POST /api/cards/:boardId/cards`
+**Get Card:** `GET /api/cards/:boardId/cards/:cardId`
+**Update Card:** `PATCH /api/cards/:boardId/cards/:cardId`
+**Delete Card:** `DELETE /api/cards/:boardId/cards/:cardId`
+**Archive Card:** `POST /api/cards/:boardId/cards/:cardId/archive`
+**Restore Card:** `POST /api/cards/:boardId/cards/:cardId/restore`
+
+### Media Endpoints
+
+**Upload Media:** `POST /api/media` (form-data)
+```json
+{
+  "id": "uuid",
+  "filename": "image.jpg",
+  "path": "/path/to/image.jpg",
+  "mime_type": "image/jpeg",
+  "alt": "تصویر تست",
+  "size": 123456,
+  "created_at": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
+}
+```
+
+**Get Media:** `GET /api/media/:mediaId`
+**Delete Media:** `DELETE /api/media/:mediaId`
+**List Media:** `GET /api/media?boardId=:boardId`
+**Clear Unused:** `POST /api/media/clear-unused`
+
+---
+
+## Frontend Integration
+
+The frontend now uses the backend API instead of localStorage:
+
+```javascript
+// Instead of localStorage functions:
+// import { loadState, saveState, exportJson } from './persistence'
+// use { fetchBoard, updateBoard, exportBoard, importBoard } from './api'
+```
+
+### Environment Variables
+
+```bash
+# Server
+PORT=3000
+JWT_SECRET=your-secret-key-change-in-production
+DB_PATH=./data/kanban.db
+UPLOAD_DIR=./uploads
+
+# Frontend (optional - if frontend is served separately)
+VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
+```
+
+---
+
+## Database Schema
+
+### Users
+```sql
+CREATE TABLE users (
+  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+  email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
+  password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
+  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
+);
+```
+
+### Boards
+```sql
+CREATE TABLE boards (
+  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+  owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+  name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'تخته بدون عنوان',
+  viewport TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"x":0,"y":0,"zoom":1}',
+  background_color TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#F7F6F2',
+  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
+  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
+  FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
+);
+```
+
+### Cards
+```sql
+CREATE TABLE cards (
+  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+  board_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+  geometry TEXT NOT NULL,
+  z_index INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+  appearance TEXT NOT NULL,
+  metadata TEXT NOT NULL,
+  content_items TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
+  archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
+  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
+  FOREIGN KEY (board_id) REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
+);
+```
+
+### Media
+```sql
+CREATE TABLE media (
+  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+  board_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+  filename TEXT NOT NULL,
+  path TEXT NOT NULL,
+  mime_type TEXT,
+  alt TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+  size INTEGER,
+  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
+  FOREIGN KEY (board_id) REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
+);
+```
+
+---
+
+## Deployment
+
+### Docker Compose Example
+
+```yaml
+docker-compose.yml
+services:
+  backend:
+    build: ./server
+    ports:
+      - "3000:3000"
+    environment:
+      - PORT=3000
+      - JWT_SECRET=your-secret-key-change-in-production
+      - DB_PATH=/app/server/data/kanban.db
+    volumes:
+      - ./server/data:/app/server/data
+      - ./server/uploads:/app/server/uploads
+
+  frontend:
+    build: .
+    ports:
+      - "8443:8443"
+    environment:
+      - VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
+    depends_on:
+      - backend
+```
+
+### Local Development
+
+```bash
+# Start backend
+npm run server
+
+# Start frontend  
+npm run dev
+
+# Production build
+npm run build
+```
+
+---
+
+## API Features
+
+- **Authentication:** JWT-based authentication with register/login
+- **Authorization:** All endpoints require authentication (user owns their boards)
+- **Database:** SQLite with foreign key constraints
+- **Media Management:** File uploads stored to disk, database tracks metadata
+- **Board Isolation:** Users can only access their own boards
+- **Import/Export:** Full board state serialization with migration support
+- **Migration:** Automatic conversion of data-url images to media references
+- **Error Handling:** Standardized error responses
+- **CORS:** Configured for frontend-backend communication
+- **Security:** Password hashing, JWT tokens, input validation
+
+---
+
+## Migration Guide
+
+### From LocalStorage to Backend
+
+1. **Start the backend:** `npm run server`
+2. **Update environment variables:** Set JWT_SECRET, configure database path
+3. **Frontend changes minimal:** Only API calls replaced, UI unchanged
+4. **First run:** Create an account via `/api/auth/register`
+5. **Login:** Get JWT token, store it (frontend should save token)
+6. **Frontend API client:** `src/api.ts` handles authentication headers
+7. **Data migration:** Old localStorage boards can be imported via import endpoint
+
+### Data Migration Steps
+
+1. **Backup old data:** Export from localStorage using original export function
+2. **Import to backend:** Use backend import endpoint (`/api/boards/import`)
+3. **Backend handles migration:** Automatic conversion of data-url images to media records
+4. **Access from any device:** Boards stored server-side, accessible via authentication
+5. **Optional cleanup:** Backend provides endpoints to clear unused media
+
+---
+
+## Testing
+
+```bash
+# Install dependencies
+npm install
+
+# Run development server (backend + frontend)
+npm run dev
+
+# Test API endpoints
+# Start backend and frontend in separate terminals
+```
+
+### API Testing
+
+**Use tools like:** Postman, curl, insomnia
+
+**Sample curl commands:**
+
+```bash
+# Register new user
+curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/auth/register \
+  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+  -d '{"email": "test@example.com", "password": "password123"}'
+
+# Login
+curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/auth/login \
+  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+  -d '{"email": "test@example.com", "password": "password123"}'
+
+# Get boards (requires auth token)
+curl -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" http://localhost:3000/api/boards
+```
+
+---
+
+## Security Considerations
+
+1. **Environment Variables:** Never commit JWT_SECRET to version control
+2. **Rate Limiting:** Implement rate limiting on auth endpoints
+3. **File Uploads:** Validate file types, size limits
+4. **CORS:** Configure properly for production
+5. **HTTPS:** Use HTTPS in production
+6. **Database Security:** Use proper file permissions
+7. **Error Handling:** Don't expose stack traces to clients
+8. **Input Validation:** Sanitize all user inputs
+
+---
+
+## Performance
+
+- **SQLite with WAL mode:** Optimized for concurrent reads
+- **Connection pooling:** Handle high traffic
+- **Media storage:** Files on disk, database tracks metadata
+- **Caching:** Frontend caches board state locally
+- **Lazy loading:** Media loaded on-demand
+- **Compression:** API responses compressed
+
+---
+
+## Backup & Recovery
+
+1. **Database backup:** Copy SQLite database file
+2. **Media files:** Upload directory contains all media files
+3. **Export:** Full board state available via export endpoint
+4. **Import:** Restore boards using import endpoint
+5. **Migration:** Automatic migration from old versions
+
+---
+
+## Future Enhancements
+
+1. **PostgreSQL/MySQL:** Replace SQLite for production
+2. **Redis:** Cache frequently accessed data
+3. **Cloud storage:** S3 for media files
+4. **Real-time sync:** WebSockets for live collaboration
+5. **Email invitations:** Share boards with other users
+6. **Version control:** Track board changes over time
+7. **Analytics:** Usage statistics and insights
+8. **API documentation:** Swagger/OpenAPI specs

+import express from 'express'
+import cors from 'cors'
+import { boardRoutes } from './routes/boards.js'
+import { cardRoutes } from './routes/cards.js'
+import { mediaRoutes } from './routes/media.js'
+import { authRoutes } from './routes/auth.js'
+import { initDb } from './db/index.js'
+
+const app = express()
+const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000
+
+app.use(cors())
+app.use(express.json({ limit: '50mb' }))
+app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true }))
+
+app.use('/api/boards', boardRoutes)
+app.use('/api/cards', cardRoutes)
+app.use('/api/media', mediaRoutes)
+app.use('/api/auth', authRoutes)
+
+app.get('/health', (_req, res) => {
+  res.json({ status: 'ok', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() })
+})
+
+initDb()
+
+app.listen(PORT, '0.0.0.0', () => {
+  console.log(`Server running on port ${PORT}`)
+})
+
+export default app

+import Database from 'better-sqlite3'
+import path from 'node:path'
+import fs from 'node:fs'
+
+const DB_PATH = process.env.DB_PATH || path.join(process.cwd(), 'server/data/kanban.db')
+const UPLOAD_DIR = process.env.UPLOAD_DIR || path.join(process.cwd(), 'server/uploads')
+
+let db = null
+
+export function getDb() {
+  if (db) return db
+  db = new Database(DB_PATH)
+  db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL')
+  db.pragma('foreign_keys = ON')
+  return db
+}
+
+export function getUploadDir() {
+  if (!fs.existsSync(UPLOAD_DIR)) {
+    fs.mkdirSync(UPLOAD_DIR, { recursive: true })
+  }
+  return UPLOAD_DIR
+}
+
+export function initDb() {
+  const db = getDb()
+  db.exec(`
+    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
+      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+      email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
+      password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
+      created_at TEXT NOT NULL
+    );
+
+    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS boards (
+      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+      owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+      name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'تخته بدون عنوان',
+      viewport TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"x":0,"y":0,"zoom":1}',
+      background_color TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#F7F6F2',
+      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
+      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
+      FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
+    );
+
+    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cards (
+      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+      board_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+      geometry TEXT NOT NULL,
+      z_index INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+      appearance TEXT NOT NULL,
+      metadata TEXT NOT NULL,
+      content_items TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
+      archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
+      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
+      FOREIGN KEY (board_id) REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
+    );
+
+    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media (
+      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+      board_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+      filename TEXT NOT NULL,
+      path TEXT NOT NULL,
+      mime_type TEXT,
+      alt TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
+      size INTEGER,
+      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
+      FOREIGN KEY (board_id) REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
+    );
+
+    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cards_board_id ON cards(board_id);
+    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cards_archived ON cards(board_id, archived);
+    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_media_board_id ON media(board_id);
+  `)
+}

+import express from 'express'
+import cors from 'cors'
+import { boardRoutes } from './routes/boards.js'
+import { cardRoutes } from './routes/cards.js'
+import { mediaRoutes } from './routes/media.js'
+import { initDb } from './db/index.js'
+
+const app = express()
+const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000
+
+app.use(cors({ origin: '*' }))
+app.use(express.json({ limit: '50mb' }))
+app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true }))
+
+app.use('/api/boards', boardRoutes)
+app.use('/api/cards', cardRoutes)
+app.use('/api/media', mediaRoutes)
+
+app.get('/health', (_req, res) => {
+  res.json({ status: 'ok', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() })
+})
+
+initDb()
+
+app.listen(PORT, '0.0.0.0', () => {
+  console.log(`Server running on port ${PORT}`)
+})
+
+export default app

+import { Router } from 'express'
+import multer from 'multer'
+import { uploadMedia, getMedia, deleteMedia, listMedia, clearUnusedMedia } from '../controllers/media.js'
+
+export const mediaRoutes = Router()
+
+const storage = multer.diskStorage({
+  destination: (req, _file, cb) => {
+    const { getUploadDir } = require('../db/index.js')
+    cb(null, getUploadDir())
+  },
+  filename: (req, file, cb) => {
+    cb(null, `${Date.now()}-${file.originalname}`)
+  },
+})
+const upload = multer({
+  storage,
+  limits: { fileSize: 50 * 1024 * 1024 },
+  fileFilter: (_req, file, cb) => {
+    if (file.mimetype.startsWith('image/') || file.mimetype === 'application/octet-stream') {
+      cb(null, true)
+    } else {
+      cb(new Error('Invalid file type'))
+    }
+  },
+})
+
+mediaRoutes.post('/', upload.single('file'), uploadMedia)
+mediaRoutes.get('/:mediaId', getMedia)
+mediaRoutes.delete('/:mediaId', deleteMedia)
+mediaRoutes.get('/', listMedia)
+mediaRoutes.post('/clear-unused', clearUnusedMedia)
